$comment: The tests that may skip, and where (HITLD-185). CI fails when a test skips that no entry here covers: an entry covers a skip when the platform is listed, the file is listed and the skip's reason contains the entry's reason. The age interoperability tests are covered on no platform: the tests job installs age, so CI always runs them. scripts/test-skips.mjs checks a run against this file.

expected.why: Windows without Developer Mode or admin cannot create symbolic links
Windows has no POSIX file modes or owners to refuse a file by

expected.reason: the stand-in tools are shell scripts
expected.why: the keychain tests stand in for the keychain tools with shell scripts

expected.reason: no keychain tool on this platform
expected.why: the store keeps a device key in a keychain only on Linux and macOS

expected.reason: no unprivileged network and PID namespaces
expected.why: GitHub's runners give no unprivileged network and PID namespaces, so CI does not exercise the reproducer sandbox's namespace layer; the real check is a run on a Linux machine that allows them
